decisions.decision: Executors dispatched directly instead of via execute-phase, and workflow.use_worktrees left untouched
decisions.rationale: D-08 forbids worktree fan-out. Flipping the config would satisfy one phase by silently changing every future phase's execution model.

decisions.decision: The browser-e2e job runs a THIRD file, tests/test_browser_e2e_skip_contract.py, beyond the two the plan named
decisions.rationale: That file did not exist when 207-04 was written (added this session for W-10). Its second leg asserts a dead server is reported loudly when Chromium IS present, and this job is the only place in CI where that is true. Omitting it would mean the leg never runs in CI.

decisions.decision: test_full_suite_ci_job_still_selects_all_markers's job-body regex was NARROWED, not the new job moved
decisions.rationale: The guard captured every indented line after its header to EOF, so any job defined after linux-full-suite was folded into the captured body -- anchored but unscoped. Moving the new job earlier would have silenced the symptom and left the trap armed for the next appended job. Red-proved both ways after narrowing: continue-on-error on linux-full-suite itself still fails, and removing its -m '' still fails.

decisions.decision: UAT-88-03's TRIAGE-149 contamination is converted to a NARROW skip in the test, not handled in production code
decisions.rationale: render_pdf_report catches PlaywrightError/TimeoutError/OSError/RuntimeError but not AttributeError, so the contamination propagated and the node FAILED where D-10 requires a skip. Broadening production exception handling would mask real failures for users to fix a test-ordering problem. The skip matches only the two-token signature; an unrelated or half-matching AttributeError still re-raises -- red-proved in all three directions.
